children: NEW YORK, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As interest in tea-based beverages continues to grow across the United States, Mixue, a brand under MIXUE Group (02097.HK), is making specialty drinks more accessible through affordable pricing and diverse flavor offerings. This summer, the brand introduced six seasonal menu items across its U.S. stores, including the first-ever U.S. debut of Green Lemon Tea and Green Lemonade. The launch has generated positive consumer feedback and social media engagement, reinforcing Mixue's commitment to delivering quality-driven, value-forward beverages for everyday consumers.

Tea-based beverages continue to gain traction in the United States, one of the world's largest tea-importing markets. Iced tea remains the dominant format, while growing demand for ready-to-drink tea, fruit-infused beverages, and health-conscious options is helping expand the category. As consumers increasingly look for alternatives to sugary soft drinks, younger generations are driving tea consumption beyond traditional breakfast occasions and into everyday refreshment moments.

In this environment, Mixue entered the U.S. market with a simple proposition: making quality tea-based beverages and soft-serve ice cream available at prices that encourage everyday enjoyment. As the world's largest freshly-made beverage and food chain by store count, the brand has gained recognition in international markets for offering a broad range of products at accessible price points, making it easier for consumers to explore new tea flavors and fruit beverages.

A key part of Mixue's ability to maintain affordable pricing lies in its global supply chain and operational efficiency. The company's value proposition is not built on lowering product quality, but on economies of scale, integrated sourcing capabilities, and streamlined operations developed through years of international expansion. These advantages enable Mixue to continuously introduce new products while keeping prices within reach of everyday consumers, making quality tea-based beverages more accessible to a wider audience.

This summer's seasonal menu has provided another example of how that strategy resonates with consumers. Since launch, several limited-time offerings have received encouraging feedback, reflecting growing demand for refreshing tea drinks. Among them, the banana-themed beverages, including Banana MIXUE Shake and Creamy Banana, have generated notable discussion on social media, with customers sharing reviews, recommendations, and product photos online.

The launch has also helped introduce Mixue to new consumers, contributing to increased brand visibility and store traffic. Beyond product discussions, some customers have expressed interest in seeing Mixue expand into additional U.S. markets, reflecting growing recognition of the brand's combination of variety, affordability, and approachable flavors.

Looking ahead, Mixue plans to continue expanding its presence in the United States through new store openings and ongoing menu innovation. By combining quality ingredients, accessible pricing, and products tailored to evolving consumer preferences, the company aims to become an increasingly familiar part of everyday refreshment occasions and modern tea culture in America.
For more information about Mixue US, please visit https://www.instagram.com/mixue.us/.

MIXUE Group is the world's leading global freshly-made drinks company. Mixue has built a comprehensive end-to-end supply chain at the largest scale in China's freshly-made drinks industry, encompassing essential aspects covering procurement, production, logistics, R&D and quality control. The company is committed to delivering high-quality, affordable fresh beverages to consumers worldwide through its extreme-efficiency global supply chain and franchise model.
